snippet.title: DEFECT - Extended 5 Minute Gameplay Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2025 Showcase
snippet.description:
Get an extended look at DEFECT, the upcoming squad-based cyberpunk shooter from emptyvessel. This five-minute gameplay showcase dives deeper into the chaos of the Last City of Mankind, where factions fight for control under the watchful eye of THE SYSTEM.

See how objectives unfold in real time, squads clash across neon-lit streets, and firefights erupt in dense urban environments. This is your best look yet at DEFECT’s fast-paced tactical action and gritty cyberpunk world.

DEFECT is currently in development. Add it to your Steam wishlist and stay tuned for more updates from Galaxies.
